stage: saved before viewing any of the 13 batch images

answers.answer: A visible smoke veil and no identified flame form in an actually visible framed region can coexist. A qualified local nondetection must retain the smoke, resolution and interior-visibility limits; it does not establish no interior fire.

Use unresolved_target and a null target_rect where foreground prevents secure candidate localization. An empty luminous_features list means none identified by this review, not no fire; omit target nondetection regions when localization or detail cannot support them.
Use ambiguous_glow for smooth orange illumination without resolved flame-like morphology, with reflection and illuminated-material alternatives. Color and brightness do not measure temperature.
Record a printed bright red numeral as a source-added overlay locator, not luminous fire evidence. Its asserted identity is not authenticated by its presence.
Overlapping rectangles are approximate feature locators. Neither their union nor their sum measures burning area, counts windows or counts fires.
Repeated camera views remain dependent within the same source family. Different figure filenames establish neither independent corroboration nor distinct or verified clocks.
